'''Kailur''' was the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Archduke/Legends|Archduke]] of a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]-allied [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. He was one of several heads of state summoned by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Arkos Rakton]] to a diplomatic summit on [[Outpost 256]], where Rakton seized the heads of state by force. Kailur and [[Premier]] [[Vonn]] almost accepted Rakton's offer to join the Empire when the captives were liberated from Rakton's forces by [[Havoc Squad]]. Afterwards, those that remained loyal to the Republic called for execution of the traitors, but Havoc Squad [[Major/Legends|Major]] refused to carry it out.
